title: Pac-Man, but you're the ghost
summary: A personal programming project that reimagines the classic Pac-Man game by reversing the roles - instead of controlling Pac-Man, the player controls the ghost to hunt down the classic yellow character through the maze.
problem_solved: Creates a fun twist on a classic arcade game that provides a fresh challenge for players familiar with the original.
why_valuable: Demonstrates creative game design thinking by inverting the classic gameplay formula to create a novel and entertaining experience.
